walkthroughs.body_html:
Sleep splits into:

  • NREM — non-REM, three stages, deepening rest.
  • REM — eyes flicker, vivid dreams.

A cycle lasts about 90 minutes.

You go through 4–5 cycles a night.

Early cycles have more deep sleep; later cycles have more REM. 💤

Your circadian rhythm is the inner 24-hour clock.

Light wakes you. Darkness releases melatonin — sleep hormone.

Phones at night confuse the clock! 📱
